description: Shared vectors for frontmatter_fingerprint_text (eval/harness/harness/snapshot.py) and frontmatterFingerprintText (eval/app/lib/snapshot.ts), issue #3568. Each `input` is the raw text of an agent .md file (JSON-escaped, so CRLF, CR, a BOM and U+2028/U+0085/U+000C survive git's text normalization). Both sides normalize it as a `.md` file, take the frontmatter fingerprint, and must produce exactly `expected_text`, whose sha256 hex is `expected_digest`. `expected_text` is written by hand, not generated by either implementation.

vectors.input:
---
name: a
description: >-
  does x
  and y
model: sonnet
tools:
  - Read
---
body
vectors.expected_text:
name: a
description: >-
  does x
  and y
tools:
  - Read
